text.title: PRFAQ Record — Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces: a PRFAQ Record as YAML or JSON, machine-checkable by the bundled validator.

contract.field: What is being judged, in one line, in the author's own words.
Selects the antagonist and the success measure per r6-concept-type-switch.
A named segment specific enough to point at a person. "Users" and "teams" fail.
What that customer cannot do today, in their vocabulary.
Where the problem was observed, with a four-digit year. A conversation, a ticket, a workaround, a payment already made to a worse option.
The judgement. No score accompanies it, ever.
Why, in prose that would still make sense to a stranger in six months.
The phase the review stopped at. Phases after it are omitted entirely.
The phase to re-enter. `revise` that names phase 5 is a `kill` in disguise.
Keys: `headline`, `subhead`, `body`, `customer_quote`, `available_from`. Past or present tense only (r2).
Each item `{q, a}`. Must include a cost question and a named-incumbent question (r4).
Each item `{q, a}`. Separate bank from `customer_faq`; must contain one the author would rather not answer (r5).
Assumptions whose falsity kills the concept. Each item `{assumption, status: confirmed|untested, disproof}`.
The cheapest act that would falsify the riskiest assumption, performable this week.
Must name the antagonist implied by `concept_type` (r6).

section.title: Early-stop condition
section.statement: A `kill` completes the record at the phase it happened. If `killed_at_phase` is 1, the record is four fields plus `verdict`, `verdict_rationale` and `killed_at_phase` — nothing else. Continuing to write a press release for a concept already killed at phase 1 is the review refusing its own verdict, and the validator rejects it.

section.title: Consistency rules the validator enforces
section.statement: No key anywhere in the record may be named `score`, `rating`, `confidence`, `weighted_score`, `points` or `total` (r7). The press release headline, subhead and body must contain no forward-looking verb form and the headline no implementation noun (r2, r3). `customer_faq` and `internal_faq` must not share a question verbatim. `success_measure` must contain the token the `concept_type` demands — pay/price/revenue for `commercial`, fund/budget for `internal`, maintain/contributor for `oss`, funder/beneficiary for `nonprofit`, bill/rate for `service`, audience for `creative`, unit/margin for `physical`. `verdict: proceed` requires every `must_be_true` item to be `confirmed` or to carry a non-empty `disproof`. `problem_evidence` must contain a four-digit year.
